layout.title: Settings
layout.description: Manage {name}, your team and your own account.

form.offline: We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

business.title: Business profile
business.description: The basics customers see on your booking page and in their emails.

basics.title: Basics
basics.description: How your business appears on your booking page and in emails to customers.
basics.name: Business name
basics.categoryHint: Helps us tailor tips and defaults to your kind of business.
basics.aboutHint: Shown at the top of your booking page. {count}/{max}
basics.aboutPlaceholder: A friendly sentence or two about what you do and what customers can expect.

time.title: Time & money
time.description: Your timezone decides how opening hours and appointment times are read. Currency is used for service prices.
time.timezoneHint: Tip: with the list focused, type a city name to jump to it.
time.tzChangedTitle: Changing your timezone changes how opening hours are read
time.tzChangedBody: Working hours like 9:00–17:00 will mean 9:00–17:00 in {tz}. Appointments already booked keep their exact moment in time, so they may show at a different clock time.
time.currencyHint: Changing the currency doesn’t convert existing prices.

language.title: Booking page language
language.description: The language customers see first on your booking page, in the booking widget and on their booking confirmation.
language.label: Default language
language.hint: Customers can still switch to another language themselves.

contact.title: Contact details
contact.description: Shown on your booking page and in confirmation emails. Customer replies to Hournook emails go to this email address.

address.title: Address
address.description: Where customers come for their appointment. Leave empty if you work remotely or visit customers.

account.title: Your account
account.intro: Personal settings for {email}. You’re {role, select, owner {the owner} manager {a manager} other {a team member}} of {business}.
account.introMany: Personal settings for {email}. You’re {role, select, owner {the owner} manager {a manager} other {a team member}} of {business} and belong to {count} businesses in total.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: How you appear to your team. Customers never see your account details.
profile.name: Your name
profile.emailHint: Used to sign in. Contact support to change it.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of your dashboard and settings.
language.label: Language
language.emailNote: Emails we send to you (new bookings, team and billing updates) are in this language too.
language.invalid: Choose one of the supported languages.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password signs you out on every other device.
password.newHint: At least {min} characters. A short phrase works well.
password.googleDescription: You sign in with Google. You can also set a password to sign in with your email.

leave.title: Leave {business}
leave.description: You’ll lose access to this business. Your appointments and profile stay with the business.
leave.confirmBody: You won’t be able to sign in to this business any more. An owner or manager can invite you again later.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.description: Permanently removes your login and personal details. This can’t be undone.
delete.ownerBody: Owners must delete their businesses, or make someone else the owner under Settings → Team, before deleting their account, so customers and bookings are never left without an owner. You own {businesses}. Delete it under Privacy & data first.
delete.body: You’ll be removed from every business you belong to. Appointments you handled stay with those businesses.
delete.dialogDescription: Enter your password to confirm. This can’t be undone.

booking.title: Booking rules
booking.description: Decide when and how customers can book, change and cancel. These apply to your whole booking page.

summary.text: Customers can book {notice}, and up to {days} in advance. Start times are offered {interval}.
summary.lastMinute: right up to the last minute

window.title: When customers can book
window.description: Protect your time: stop last-minute surprises and decide how far ahead your calendar opens.
window.minNoticeHint: How soon before an appointment someone can still book it online.
window.maxAdvanceHint: How far into the future customers can see free times.
window.startTimesHint: With every 15 minutes, customers see 9:00, 9:15, 9:30… Longer steps keep your day tidier.
window.limitDescription: Once the limit is reached, that day shows as full. You can still add appointments yourself.

confirm.title: Confirmation
confirm.description: Choose whether new bookings are final straight away.
confirm.review: Review each booking before it’s confirmed
confirm.reviewOn: New online bookings arrive as requests. The time is held, and the customer gets a confirmation email once you accept it.
confirm.reviewOff: Bookings are confirmed instantly and the customer gets their confirmation email right away.

changes.title: Cancelling & rescheduling
changes.description: Every confirmation email has a link customers can use to manage their booking. Decide what they can do themselves.
changes.cancelOn: Freed-up times become bookable again automatically.
changes.cancelOff: Customers need to contact you to cancel.
changes.cancelDeadlineHint: After this point the cancel button disappears and customers are asked to contact you.
changes.rescheduleOn: They pick a new free time; the old one is released.
changes.rescheduleOff: Customers need to contact you to move a booking.
changes.rescheduleDeadlineHint: How close to the appointment customers can still move it.

reminders.title: Reminder emails
reminders.description: Automatic reminders cut no-shows. Pick up to {max}. Customers without an email address won’t get them.
reminders.selected: {count} of {max} selected: {list}. Changes apply to future bookings.

form.title: Booking form
form.description: What customers are asked when they book.

optional.title: Customer may choose
optional.body: Customers can pick a team member or choose “Any available”.

required.title: Customer must choose
required.body: Customers always pick a specific team member.

hidden.title: Don’t ask
hidden.body: We assign whoever is free. Customers never see a choice.

required.title: Required
required.body: Best if you call or text customers.

hidden.title: Don’t ask
hidden.body: The field isn’t shown at all.

form.alwaysAsked: Name and email are always asked for, so we can send confirmations.

mine.title: Your notifications
mine.description: Choose what we tell you about. This only affects you; each team member sets their own.
mine.remindersByManager: Reminder emails to customers are set up by an owner or manager under Booking settings.
mine.verifyEmail: Verify your email address to receive notification emails. Until then they only appear in your inbox.

customers.title: Customer emails
customers.description: How your automatic emails to customers look.
customers.remindersLink: Looking for appointment reminders? They’re set under <link>Booking rules</link>.

email.title: Emails to your customers
email.description: Confirmations, reminders and change notices are sent automatically for every booking.
email.senderNameHint: What customers see in their inbox. Leave empty to use “{business}”.
email.footerHint: A short note at the bottom of every email, e.g. parking tips or your cancellation policy. {count}/{max}
email.footerPlaceholder: Free parking behind the building. Please arrive 5 minutes early.
email.defaultFooter: You received this email because you booked an appointment.
email.sentBy: Sent by Hournook on behalf of {business}.
email.whyTitle: Why emails come from Hournook’s address
email.whyBody: To keep your emails out of spam folders, they’re sent from Hournook’s verified address with your business name as the sender. We never pretend to send from your own domain. When customers hit reply, their message goes straight to {email}.
email.whyBodyNoEmail: To keep your emails out of spam folders, they’re sent from Hournook’s verified address with your business name as the sender. We never pretend to send from your own domain. When customers hit reply, their message goes straight to your business email. <link>Add a contact email</link> so replies reach you.

prefs.title: Notify me about
prefs.descriptionOwn: Only about your own appointments. Changes save automatically.
prefs.descriptionAll: Sent to you by email and shown in your inbox (the bell icon). Changes save automatically.
prefs.createdOwn: When a customer books an appointment with you.
prefs.createdAll: When a customer books online or a teammate adds an appointment.
prefs.rescheduledOwn: When one of your appointments moves to a new time.
prefs.rescheduledAll: When an appointment is moved to a new time.
prefs.cancelledOwn: When one of your appointments is cancelled.
prefs.cancelledAll: When a customer or teammate cancels an appointment.
prefs.teamDescription: When someone accepts an invitation and joins your team.
prefs.billingDescription: Payment problems and subscription changes. We recommend leaving this on.
prefs.saveFailed: We couldn’t save that change. Check your connection and try again.

team.title: Team & access
team.description: Invite colleagues to sign in with their own login. To add someone who just takes bookings (without a login), add them under <link>Team</link> in the sidebar.

roleDescriptions.owner: Everything, including billing, exporting all data and deleting the business.
roleDescriptions.manager: Everything except billing, deleting the business, exporting all data and erasing customers.
roleDescriptions.staff: Only their own appointments, customers they’ve seen, and their own availability.

explainer.title: What each role can do
explainer.description: Pick the smallest role someone needs. You can change it later.

invite.title: Invite to your team
invite.description: They’ll get an email with a link to join. No extra cost: your plan includes the whole team.
invite.linkHint: If this person already has a profile in your team (with bookings and working hours), link it so they see their own schedule. Otherwise a new profile is created when they join.
invite.sentDescription: The link is valid for 7 days.
invite.createdDescription: We couldn’t send the email right now. Revoke it and invite again later.

members.title: Members · {count}
members.description: People who can sign in to this business.

invites.title: Pending invitations
invites.description: Invitations expire after 7 days. Invite the same address again to send a fresh link.
invites.emptyDescription: Invite a colleague so they can see their schedule and manage their own appointments.

transfer.title: Make {name} the owner?
transfer.description: They’ll get full control, including billing and deleting the business. You’ll stay on the team as a manager. Only the new owner can undo this.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: They’ll lose access to this business straight away. Their profile, past appointments and upcoming bookings stay in your calendar, and you can reassign or cancel them later.

toasts.roleChanged: {name} is now {role, select, manager {a manager} owner {the owner} other {a team member}}

errors.staffHasAccount: This team member already has an account.
errors.alreadyOnTeam: This person is already on your team.
errors.profileLinked: This team profile is already linked to another account. Ask for a new invitation.
errors.alreadyMember: You are already a member of this business.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.description: Your data belongs to you. Download it any time, see what we keep, and handle customer requests.

download.title: Download your data
download.description: Exports are generated on the spot and logged in your activity. Handle files with customer details carefully.
download.ownerOnly: Only the owner can download the complete export.

all.title: Everything (JSON)
all.description: Your complete account: profile, services, team, hours, booking rules, customers, appointments and activity log. Machine-readable, for backups or moving to another tool.

customers.title: Customers (CSV)
customers.description: All customers with contact details and visit history. Opens in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets.

appointments.title: Appointments (CSV)
appointments.description: Every appointment from the last 12 months and the next 12 months.

services.title: Services (CSV)
services.description: Your service menu with durations and prices.

stored.title: What we store and for how long
stored.description: Hournook processes this data on your behalf to run your bookings. We never sell it or use it for advertising.

business.detail: Your profile, services, prices, opening hours, team profiles and booking rules.
business.keep: Until you change or delete them.

customers.detail: Name, email, phone, your internal notes and their appointment history.
customers.keep: Until you erase the customer or delete the business.

appointments.detail: Date, time, service, team member, status and messages from the customer.
appointments.keep: Until you delete the business. Erased customers’ appointments stay as anonymous records.

emails.detail: A delivery log of confirmations and reminders we sent.
emails.keep: Email contents are removed after 180 days; the delivery status stays.

visits.detail: Anonymous page views and booking steps for your analytics. No cookies, no personal data.

activity.detail: Who changed what in your account, with the time and IP address.

sessions.detail: The devices you and your team are signed in on.
sessions.keep: Expire after 30 days, or straight away when you sign out.

stored.stripe: Card payments for your subscription are handled by Stripe. We never see or store card numbers. Read the full <link>privacy policy</link>.

requests.title: Customer requests
requests.description: When a customer asks for a copy of their data or to be forgotten.
requests.accessBody: Open the customer’s page to see everything stored about them (details, notes and every appointment) and share it with them.
requests.erasureBody: On the customer’s page, choose Erase customer data. Their name, email, phone, notes and messages are removed for good, and pending reminders are cancelled. Appointments stay as anonymous records so your statistics add up.
requests.ownerOnly: Only the owner can erase customers.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.deleteBody: Permanently deletes {business}, its booking page and all customer and appointment data. Team members lose access. This can’t be undone.
danger.deleteBodySubscribed: Permanently deletes {business}, its booking page and all customer and appointment data. Your subscription is cancelled immediately. Team members lose access. This can’t be undone.
danger.confirmBody: This permanently deletes your booking page, services, team profiles, customers, appointments and uploaded images. Customers with upcoming appointments won’t be notified automatically.
danger.confirmSubscription: Your Hournook subscription is cancelled right away, so you won’t be charged again.
danger.confirmFinal: This can’t be undone. Download an export first if you might need the data.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: A record of important changes in {business}: who did what, and when. Times are shown in {tz}.
activity.emptyDescription: Changes to your business, bookings and team will be listed here.
activity.emptyMoreDescription: You’ve reached the beginning of your history.

detail.asRole: {role, select, owner {as owner} manager {as manager} other {as team member}}

availability.staffUsesBusinessHours: Team member now follows business hours

actions.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
